headline: Exchange Intake Falls To 1,766.0 Million Dollars From 2,148.0 Million As Binance Drops To 1,124.3 Million
narrative: Clean-asset intake across 79 venues fell to 1,766.0 million dollars, 0.6466 percent of the 273.1 billion dollars held there excluding each venue's own token, from 2,148.0 million dollars. Binance intake dropped to 1,124.3 million dollars from 1,538.7 million dollars, while Bitget took in 583.2 million dollars. The pipe measures the change in dollars held on the venues excluding each exchange's own token, so the smaller positive total means less money arrived than in the prior reading, with Binance still the largest arrival and the source of the drop.
author: jordan
